resources.string: How far to turn the device from wherever it is right now, before turning it back. Any direction works. 180° = a full flip over.
Allowed slack on both halves of the movement: the turn can fall this many degrees short, and the device only has to come back to within this many degrees of where it started.
Maximum time for the whole movement
Over and back must be completed within this time to count.
Recommended: stops Android from killing the service while the screen is off.
Turn the device over and back to wake the screen.
